name: Courts Of Justice
overview: Scripture reveals that courts of justice were integral to community life, with decisions often made publicly and transparently, as seen when Abraham secured property before witnesses at the city gate (Genesis 23:17-20). Judicial proceedings were thorough and could extend throughout the day, exemplified by Moses judging the people from morning until evening (Exodus 18:13-14). These courts handled matters ranging from property transfers to legal disputes, emphasizing fairness and accountability under God’s law.
